destinations.titleHtml: Four hundred and fifty destinations, one careful index.
destinations.lead: Every place here has been visited, photographed, or independently verified. Filter by what you want — mountains for solitude, islands for slowness, heritage for the stories etched into stone.

packages.lead: Sponsored placements are flagged. Affiliate links are flagged. Quote-on-request packages are clearly marked. You'll always know which is which.

blog.lead: Long-form essays, photo essays, and field notes. Stories from people who actually went there. Four layout templates, one editorial standard.

announcements.lead: Every notice we've ever published — package launches, destination additions, editorial features, partner promotions, gallery updates, and shop releases. Sorted by date, filterable by type.

gallery.lead: Photographs and footage from the road — fifty videos and fifty images, taken by our editors and trusted contributors. Hover to preview. Click for the full-screen view.

picks.titleHtml: Four lists. Twenty places each. One careful index.
picks.lead: The destinations we'd send our closest friends — ranked, reasoned, updated quarterly by editors who've been to every place on the list. Pick the type. We've done the rest.

legalDocs.title: Privacy policy.
legalDocs.deck: How we collect, store, and use information about visitors to the Triplipi platform.
legalDocs.body:
Effective 1 March 2026

Overview

Triplipi ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have about how we handle your information. By using Triplipi.example, you agree to the practices described below.

Information we collect

1.1 — Information you provide

When you contact us, request a quote, or sign up for our newsletter, we collect the information you submit voluntarily, including your name, email address, phone number, and any message content. This information is used only to respond to you and is never sold to third parties.

1.2 — Automatically collected information

We collect standard server logs, including IP address, browser type, referring page, and time of visit. We use Google Analytics to understand aggregate traffic patterns. You can opt out of Google Analytics via your browser settings or by installing the official Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

1.3 — Cookies

We use cookies for session management, preferences, and analytics. See our Cookies Policy for the complete list and how to manage them.

How we use information

  • To respond to your inquiries and provide the services you request
  • To send newsletters or updates, if you have opted in
  • To improve our website, content, and user experience
  • To comply with legal obligations

External providers and affiliate links

Our platform includes links to verified partner websites, including travel package providers, hotels, and affiliate platforms. When you click an external link, a consent modal will appear informing you of:

  • The name and URL of the destination site
  • Our affiliate disclosure, if applicable
  • What browser information may be shared via standard HTTP referrer mechanisms

You must explicitly consent before any redirect occurs. No personal account information from Triplipi is shared with external providers.

Your rights

Under applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information. To exercise any of these rights, please contact privacy@Triplipi.example. We will respond within 30 days.

Data retention

We retain personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected. Contact form submissions are retained for two years for record-keeping. Newsletter subscriptions are retained until you unsubscribe.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting a notice on our home page and updating the "Last updated" date above. Continued use of the site after such notice constitutes acceptance of the changes.

Contact

For privacy-related inquiries, please write to privacy@Triplipi.example or use our contact form.

legalDocs.title: Cookies policy.
legalDocs.deck: A complete list of cookies we use and how to manage them.
legalDocs.body:
Effective 1 March 2026

What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They are used to remember your preferences, track sessions, and analyse aggregate traffic patterns.

Cookies we use

Essential cookies

These are required for the platform to function: session cookies, cookie consent state, and search preferences. They cannot be disabled.

Analytics cookies

We use Google Analytics 4 (cookies prefixed _ga) to understand aggregate traffic. These cookies expire after 13 months. You can opt out via the cookie banner or by installing the official Google opt-out add-on.

Affiliate tracking cookies

When you click a sponsored or affiliate link and consent to redirect, the destination site may set a cookie that allows our affiliate relationship to be tracked. This is set by the third party, not by us. See our Affiliate Disclosure for details.

Managing cookies

Most browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies via settings. Doing so may affect some platform functionality. For detailed help, refer to your browser's help pages.

legalDocs.title: Disclaimer.
legalDocs.deck: Limitations on the accuracy and use of information published on Triplipi.
legalDocs.body:
Effective 1 March 2026

Accuracy of information

Triplipi publishes information about travel destinations, packages, weather windows, prices, and partner services in good faith. We make reasonable efforts to verify and update content, but cannot guarantee that all information is current, complete, or error-free at the time of your visit.

Travel risks

Travel — particularly to remote, high-altitude, or unfamiliar locations — carries inherent risks. Information on Triplipi is offered as a starting point for planning, not as a substitute for professional advice or safety briefings. Always:

  • Verify visa, permit, and entry requirements with official sources
  • Consult a qualified medical professional before high-altitude travel
  • Purchase appropriate travel insurance
  • Follow local laws, customs, and safety guidance

Third-party services

Bookings made through partner websites are governed by the partner's terms. Triplipi is not a party to those transactions and is not liable for service failures, cancellations, or disputes between you and the provider. Our role is editorial and referral; not contractual.

Pricing

Prices shown for packages and services are indicative at the time of publication. Final pricing is set by the partner and may change. Always confirm current pricing on the partner's site before booking.

legalDocs.title: Affiliate disclosure.
legalDocs.deck: How we earn money, and what that means for you.
legalDocs.body:
Effective 1 March 2026

How Triplipi is funded

Triplipi is funded by two sources: (1) commissions from verified partners when you book through our links, and (2) photography and footage licensing through our Shop. We do not charge readers, and we do not run a paywall.

Affiliate relationships

When we link to a partner's site for a package, hotel, or service, we may receive a commission if you book through that link. This does not affect what you pay. Our editorial team has no commercial pressure to favour any partner over another, and we publish our methodology openly.

How we disclose

Every external link on Triplipi triggers a consent modal that displays:

  • The name and URL of the destination
  • Whether we have an affiliate relationship with the destination
  • What browser information may be shared via standard referrer headers

You must check two consent boxes — affirming you understand the disclosure and consent to data sharing — before any redirect occurs. You can also decline and stay on Triplipi.

Sponsored content

Some packages and destinations are labelled "Sponsored". This means the partner has paid for editorial placement or featured-listing position. Sponsored content is always clearly labelled with a visible tag, and the editorial content itself is not influenced by the sponsor — our writers retain full control over what we say.

Advertising

Triplipi does not currently run display advertising. If we introduce it in the future, this page will be updated first, and any third-party ads will be clearly distinguishable from editorial content.

Independence

Our editorial integrity is the foundation of the platform. If we recommend a place or a partner, it is because our editors believe in it — not because we are paid to.

legalDocs.title: Frequently asked questions.
legalDocs.deck: Answers to the questions we hear most often.
legalDocs.body:
General

Is Triplipi a travel agency?

No. We are an editorial discovery platform. We don't sell trips ourselves — we refer you to verified partners with full disclosure. Think of us as a guidebook with hyperlinks.

Do you charge for content?

No. All editorial content — destination guides, blog posts, Our Picks lists, gallery viewing — is free to read. We're funded by partner commissions, photography licensing, and display ads.

Can I trust the partners you link to?

Every partner in our network has been personally vetted by our team — usually by travelling with them, sometimes by independent verification. We disclose our commercial relationship on every link via a consent modal. We label "Sponsored" placements clearly.

Booking & Quotes

How do I book a trip?

Browse destinations, find a package that suits you, click through (with consent) to the verified partner, and book on their site. Or fill our contact form with what you're thinking about, and we'll write back within one working day.

Do you offer customised itineraries?

Yes — through our partner network. Request a custom quote via any package page or the contact form, and we'll match you with the best-fit partner.

Photography & Shop

Can I license your photography?

Yes. Visit the Shop to browse our archive. Select the items you want, request a quote, and we'll come back to you with editorial, commercial, and extended-license options. A subset of our work is also available for instant licensing on Shutterstock.

Do you accept contributor submissions?

We work with a small group of trusted contributors. If you'd like to be considered, write to editorial@Triplipi.example with your portfolio.

Account & Privacy

Do I need an account?

No. Triplipi can be browsed entirely without an account. Trip drafts and shop selections persist locally in your browser only.

How do I unsubscribe from the newsletter?

Every newsletter has an unsubscribe link at the bottom. Alternatively, write to hello@Triplipi.example and we'll remove you within 24 hours.
